executive_summary: Maven build failed with 22 compilation errors. The primary issue is that a custom Column class conflicts with JPA's @Column annotation, causing type conversion errors across multiple entity classes. Additionally, there are method signature mismatches and missing setter methods.

errors.message: incompatible types: Column cannot be converted to java.lang.annotation.Annotation (19 occurrences across Column.java, Task.java, User.java)
errors.root_cause: Custom Column class name conflicts with JPA @Column annotation. The compiler is trying to use the custom Column class where @Column annotation is expected on entity fields.
errors.fix_recommendation: Rename the custom Column entity class to avoid conflict with JPA @Column annotation. Suggested names: BoardColumn, TaskColumn, or ColumnEntity. Update all references including imports, repositories, services, and controllers.

errors.message: method getUserTasks cannot be applied to given types; required: Long,Pageable found: Long,int,int,String
errors.root_cause: TaskController is calling getUserTasks with 4 parameters (userId, page, size, sortBy) but TaskService interface expects 2 parameters (userId, Pageable).
errors.fix_recommendation: In TaskController.java line 46, create a Pageable object from the page, size, and sortBy parameters using PageRequest.of(page, size, Sort.by(sortBy)) and pass it to getUserTasks method along with userId.

errors.message: cannot find symbol: method setLastUpdated(LocalDateTime) (2 occurrences at lines 41 and 56)
errors.root_cause: Column entity class is missing the setLastUpdated() method, but InMemoryColumnDataStore attempts to call it when creating and updating columns.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add setLastUpdated(LocalDateTime lastUpdated) method to the Column entity class. Ensure the lastUpdated field exists with proper getter and setter methods, or use Lombok @Data/@Setter annotation.

errors.message: Build failed during compilation phase preventing test execution
errors.root_cause: Compilation errors prevented the build from reaching the test phase. Tests were skipped due to -DskipTests flag, but would have failed anyway due to compilation issues.
errors.fix_recommendation: Fix all compilation errors first. After successful compilation, remove -DskipTests flag to run tests and verify application context loads correctly.
